message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large human figure dressed as a magician in a black tuxedo, red vest, and a black top hat with a red band. He stands on a wooden stage in front of a red curtain. The magician has his hands on several stacked wooden boxes with red and yellow frames.

Inside these boxes are stylized human figures or body parts. The top box contains a man’s torso in a white shirt and red tie with arms crossed. Below it, a box contains a woman’s head with glasses and a downward-turned mouth. The magician holds a third box featuring a man’s head with glasses. The bottom section consists of two stacked boxes: the upper one shows a man’s head with an angry expression, and the lowermost box shows a pair of legs in black high heels.

White text overlays the scene. At the top, it reads "Aktor Baru Korupsi Laptop Nadiem Makarim H.28" and "Wisata Premium Komodo Jalan Terus H.84." Large bold text on the left states "KEPEPET ROMBAK KABINET," followed by smaller paragraphs. The background includes the large grey word "TEMPO." Bottom text includes dates "15-21 SEPTEMBER 2025," a price, a barcode, and a QR code.
